verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for a database-branching service, but the evidence shows no documented way to self-host Ardent itself. The 'self-hosted' docs mention refers to the source Postgres database Ardent connects to, not to running Ardent. The data-plane/control-plane split never says customers can deploy either plane, and a community commenter notes Ardent doesn't appear to be open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
